title: Style
content: Thanks for all the fascinating and helpful comments inyesterday's postabout the subject of teachers drawing on top of student work.To follow up and finish, here's a twelve panel cartoon called "Style," by A. B. Frost, published in Scribners in 1891. Note that the young artist asks the older artist to rework his piece, so he has only himself to blame for the calamatous result. (Click to enlarge.)
